rationale.complete: Two rounds done (D3 ordering, then the redirected KW superagent programme R4-R8 with synthetic validation, coordination-based candidates and 19 period cards); no holdout run yet, and the main agency tests turned out unidentifiable at village sampling.
rationale.faithfulness: The KW superagent model's core predictions failed or were null (no individuality maxima, no semantic information, no repair); only the necessary condition (allocation continuity) and the goal-scramble sign held. C = 1, D = 0.
rationale.usefulness: A clear operational negative with a usable corollary: work persistence across resets lives in agents' own artifacts and the prompt, not in teams or memory, so make work state legible in the repo. Night continuity is a cheap diagnostic anyone can compute.
